candidate_triage.title: Trace external links into web code
candidate_triage.rationale: More than one clue points to a testable path; no data flow or security impact has been demonstrated.
missing_steps: Verify the missing connection: No path from a link parameter to the bundled web-code sink has been verified.
Reproduce a security impact under controlled conditions.
Identify affected versions and check prior advisories.
candidate_triage.attack_scenario: If a link parameter flows into the bundled dynamic-code or HTML-writing call, a link sender could influence WebView content. The two clues coexist, but no data flow has been traced.

notes: Alerts are changes in evidence between two researcher-supplied snapshots, not intrusion detections.
App Privacy Report describes a rolling seven-day window; newly observed domains do not prove malicious activity.
A lead no longer observed is not a verified fix, especially when scan coverage or app version changed.
Candidate triage ranks missing research steps; it does not estimate CVE probability or assign an ID.
